MEET YOUR CHAUFFEUR

Meet Jesse — Your Private Chauffeur

Jesse is the chauffeur behind JESSE PRIVATE CHAUFFEUR, a professional transport service based in Nanyuki and serving clients across Kenya.

The main service is Private Chauffeur Services for clients who want a professional driver for airport transfers, business travel, road trips, long-distance journeys, events and private travel.

Jesse also provides Personal Driver Services for clients who want him to drive their own car, as well as Taxi Services for local and point-to-point travel.

Clients travelling to Kenya from abroad can arrange their booking in advance, including airport pickup and transport plans before they arrive. The goal is simple: safe, fast and professional travel with direct booking and clear communication.
